sloka: ततो ऽहमहमित्येव गर्जन्तो नैर्ऋतर्षभाः।रावणस्य सुता वीराः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमाः ।। ६.६९.१० ।।
transliteration: tato 'hamahamityeva garjanto nairṛtarṣabhāḥ।rāvaṇasya sutā vīrāḥ śakratulyaparākramāḥ ।। 6.69.10 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana's sons, the heroes, and bulls among ogres, equal to Indra in valour, roared saying, "I will start", "I will lead."
